name: Finance Function Assessment
description: Score the maturity of each finance capability, record evidence, and rank the gaps that create the most risk over the next two quarters.

fields.label: Capability area
fields.help: Assess one area per row.

fields.label: Current state
fields.help: What actually happens today, not what the policy says.

fields.label: Maturity score (1-5)
fields.help: 1 is ad hoc and undocumented, 5 is automated and tested.

fields.label: Evidence reviewed
fields.help: Documents, systems, or interviews that support the score.

fields.label: Gap description
fields.help: State the gap in terms of the risk it creates.

name: Stakeholder Map and Listening Tour Tracker
description: Plan and record listening tour conversations so answers can be compared across stakeholders instead of remembered individually.

fields.label: Depends on finance for
fields.help: What they need that finance produces.

fields.label: Finance depends on them for
fields.help: Inputs finance needs from them and when.

name: Finance Hiring Scorecard
description: Define the trigger, sequence, budget, and evaluation criteria for each finance role before opening a requisition.

fields.label: Hiring sequence number
fields.help: Controller coverage comes first when it is not already full-time.

fields.label: Trigger justifying the hire
fields.help: State the measurable condition, not a general desire for capacity.

fields.label: Fully loaded annual cost
fields.help: Include taxes, benefits, equity expense, and equipment.

fields.label: First 90-day outcomes
fields.help: What must be true 90 days after the start date.

fields.label: Interim coverage plan
fields.help: Who does this work until the role is filled.

name: Monthly Close Calendar and Checklist
description: Assign every close task a working day, a preparer, a reviewer, and a required output so the close does not depend on memory.

fields.label: Working day
fields.help: Business day relative to period end. Use negative values for pre-close tasks.

fields.label: Reviewer
fields.help: Must be a different person from the preparer.

fields.label: Depends on
fields.help: Task or external input that must complete first.

fields.label: Required output
fields.help: The artifact that evidences completion.

name: Account Reconciliation Template
description: Standard reconciliation format with balance, supporting detail, reconciling items, aging, and reviewer sign-off.

fields.label: Difference
fields.help: Must be zero or fully explained by reconciling items.

fields.label: Reconciling items
fields.help: Describe each item, its amount, and its age.

fields.label: Oldest open item date
fields.help: Used to monitor aging of unresolved differences.

name: Chart of Accounts and Dimension Design
description: Design the account and dimension structure so management reporting comes directly from the ledger rather than from spreadsheets.

fields.label: Financial statement line
fields.help: Where this account rolls up in external reporting.

fields.label: Required dimensions
fields.help: For example department, cost center, product, entity.

fields.label: Legacy account mapping
fields.help: Old account this replaces, for conversion.

fields.label: Usage rule
fields.help: When to use this account and when not to.

name: Accounting Policy Register
description: Track each written accounting policy, its owner, its approval, and the date it must next be reviewed.

fields.label: Policy summary
fields.help: State the position in plain language.

name: Revenue Recognition Memo
description: Document the five-step analysis for a revenue stream or contract type in a format an auditor can review directly.

fields.label: Contract summary
fields.help: Parties, term, pricing structure, and deliverables.

fields.label: Performance obligations identified
fields.help: List each obligation and why it is distinct.

fields.label: Transaction price
fields.help: Include variable consideration and any constraint applied.

fields.label: Allocation to obligations
fields.help: Standalone selling price basis and method.

fields.label: Recognition timing
fields.help: Point in time or over time, with the measure of progress.

fields.label: Principal versus agent conclusion
fields.help: Required where a third party is involved in delivery.

fields.label: Contract cost treatment
fields.help: Commission capitalization and amortization period.

name: Audit Requested Items Tracker
description: Track every auditor request with an owner, a due date, and a link to the delivered support so nothing stalls silently.

name: Annual Operating Plan Builder
description: Capture plan assumptions by department with the driver, the source, and the owner so every number in the plan is traceable.

fields.label: Driver
fields.help: For example headcount, revenue percentage, or per-unit cost.

fields.label: Basis for the assumption
fields.help: Historical actuals, vendor quote, benchmark, or judgment.

fields.label: Downside sensitivity
fields.help: What this line becomes in the downside case.

name: KPI Dictionary
description: Define every reported metric once with its formula, source, owner, and known limitations so reports stop disagreeing.

fields.label: Plain-language definition
fields.help: Explain it in one sentence a new employee would understand.

fields.label: Formula
fields.help: Be explicit about inclusions and exclusions.

fields.label: Known limitations
fields.help: Where this metric is misleading or incomplete.

name: Board Package Outline
description: Structure the board package so each section has an owner, a purpose, and a clear ask rather than a stream of charts.

fields.label: Purpose
fields.help: Be honest about which one this is.

fields.label: Key message
fields.help: The single sentence a director should remember.

fields.label: Decision requested
fields.help: Required when the purpose is decide.

name: Budget Variance Analysis
description: Capture variance by department with the owner's explanation, root cause, and the corrective action agreed.

fields.label: Owner explanation
fields.help: Written by the budget owner, not by finance.

name: Finance Decision Memo
description: A one-page format for any material decision: options considered, recommendation, risks, and the approval obtained.

fields.label: Background
fields.help: What prompted this decision and what constraints apply.

fields.label: Options considered
fields.help: Include the option of doing nothing.

fields.label: Financial impact
fields.help: Cost, cash timing, and effect on the plan and runway.

fields.label: Approver
fields.help: Must match the delegation of authority matrix.

name: Deal Desk Review Form
description: Standard submission for non-standard deals covering pricing, margin, cash timing, and revenue recognition impact.

fields.label: Non-standard terms requested
fields.help: Service commitments, custom deliverables, termination rights, or caps.

name: Collections and Receivables Tracker
description: Work aged receivables with a defined outreach sequence, promised payment dates, and escalation status.

fields.label: Account owner
fields.help: Sales or success owner engaged for escalation.

name: Unit Economics Worksheet
description: Compute acquisition cost, payback, lifetime value, and contribution margin by segment with every assumption stated.

fields.label: Segment
fields.help: For example enterprise, mid-market, self-serve, or channel.

fields.label: Sales and marketing spend
fields.help: State whether fully loaded including salaries.

fields.label: Assumptions and exclusions
fields.help: State what is excluded from the cost base and why.

name: Finance Systems Architecture Map
description: Record every finance system, its owner, its cost, its renewal date, and how data moves in and out of it.

fields.label: System of record for
fields.help: Which data domain this system authoritatively owns.

fields.label: Manual effort per month in hours

name: System Access Review
description: Quarterly evidence that each user's access to each finance system is still appropriate.

fields.label: Can approve transactions
fields.help: Flag any user who can both initiate and approve.

name: Expense and Procurement Policy Builder
description: Set spend categories, limits, approval routing, documentation requirements, and exception handling in one place.

fields.label: Required documentation
fields.help: Receipts, quotes, business justification, or security review.

name: Vendor Selection and Request for Proposal Scorecard
description: Compare vendors on weighted requirements, implementation effort, total cost, security, and exit rights.

fields.label: Weight
fields.help: Total weights should sum to a consistent scale across requirements.

fields.label: Evidence of score
fields.help: Demonstration, reference call, or documentation reviewed.

name: 13-Week Cash Forecast
description: Direct-method weekly cash forecast with receipts, disbursements, minimum balance thresholds, and forecast accuracy tracking.

fields.label: Minimum balance threshold
fields.help: Flag any week that falls below this level.

fields.label: Actual closing balance
fields.help: Populate after the week closes to measure accuracy.

name: Treasury and Investment Policy
description: Define objectives, permitted instruments, maturity and concentration limits, authority, and reporting requirements for corporate cash.

fields.label: Objective priority order
fields.help: State capital preservation, liquidity, and yield in priority order.

fields.label: Minimum operating balance
fields.help: Should cover a defined number of payroll cycles.

name: Bank Selection and Relationship Review
description: Compare banking partners on service, fraud controls, integration, credit appetite, and resilience rather than on rate alone.

fields.label: Fraud controls available
fields.help: Positive pay, account validation, dual approval, and callback verification.

fields.label: Integration capability
fields.help: Direct feeds to the accounting system and payment file formats.

fields.label: Deposit or sweep yield offered
fields.help: Record as offered and note that terms change frequently.

name: Debt Covenant Tracker
description: Track every covenant, its test date, the calculation, the headroom, and the reporting deliverable that accompanies it.

fields.label: Requirement
fields.help: State the exact threshold and the defined terms used.

fields.label: Forecast breach date
fields.help: Leave empty if the forecast shows no breach.

name: Tax Compliance Calendar
description: Every filing and payment obligation with jurisdiction, frequency, owner, reviewer, and filing evidence.

name: Sales Tax Nexus Analysis
description: Assess economic and physical nexus by state, quantify exposure, and prioritize registration and remediation.

fields.label: Product taxability conclusion
fields.help: Whether the product is taxable in this state and on what basis.

fields.label: Estimated exposure including interest and penalty

name: Research Credit Documentation
description: Capture qualifying projects, activities, personnel, and costs contemporaneously so the credit is defensible.

fields.label: Business component
fields.help: The product, process, or software being developed or improved.

fields.label: Technical uncertainty
fields.help: What was uncertain at the outset about capability, method, or design.

fields.label: Process of experimentation
fields.help: Alternatives evaluated and how they were tested.

name: Transfer Pricing Arrangement Summary
description: Record each intercompany arrangement, the pricing method, the support, and whether the agreement is executed.

fields.label: Arrangement
fields.help: For example services, cost sharing, distribution, or licensing.

fields.label: Benchmark support
fields.help: Study, comparable set, or advisor opinion relied upon.

name: Enterprise Risk Register
description: Record each risk with its owner, scoring, current mitigation, and the action required to reduce it.

fields.label: Description
fields.help: Describe the event and the consequence, not just the topic.

name: Key Controls Matrix
description: Map each risk to the control that addresses it, the owner, the frequency, and the evidence the control produces.

fields.label: Control description
fields.help: State who does what, when, and against what criteria.

fields.label: Evidence produced
fields.help: A control with no evidence cannot be tested.

name: Delegation of Authority Matrix
description: Define who may commit the company to what, by transaction type and amount, up to the board threshold.

fields.label: Threshold to
fields.help: Leave empty for no upper limit below the board threshold.

fields.label: Enforced in system
fields.help: Limits that are not configured in a system are advisory only.

name: Cap Table Reconciliation and Dilution Worksheet
description: Reconcile equity activity to board approvals and model pool consumption and dilution scenarios.

fields.label: Approval reference
fields.help: Consent or minutes reference supporting this position.

fields.label: Valuation reference
fields.help: The valuation that supports this strike price.

name: 409A Valuation Preparation Pack
description: Assemble the information a valuation provider needs and record the resulting approval so grants are supported.

fields.label: Financial information provided
fields.help: Historical actuals, forecast, and cap table as of the valuation date.

fields.label: Safe harbor expiry date
fields.help: Typically twelve months or the next material event, whichever is earlier.

name: Workforce Plan and Requisition Tracker
description: Track every approved position against the budget with start date, fully loaded cost, and requisition status.

fields.label: Location
fields.help: Drives payroll registration and fully loaded cost.

name: Entity and Governance Calendar
description: Track every entity obligation and governance event with jurisdiction, due date, owner, and filing evidence.

name: Insurance Coverage Review
description: Compare each policy against risk exposure and contractual requirements, and record renewal actions.

fields.label: Contractual requirement
fields.help: Minimum limits customer contracts require.

name: Board Approval Request
description: Prepare a board or committee approval request with the action, the rationale, the financial impact, and the consent reference.

fields.label: Approval requirement basis
fields.help: Charter provision, financing agreement, plan document, or authority matrix.
